h.cadcraft.place: Draw the roof truss layout plan
h.cadcraft.pick: Take outline from the selected closed polyline
h.cadcraft.nopoly: Select a closed polyline (the roof's plan) first.
h.cadcraft.table: Draw the cut list and joint schedule
h.cadcraft.drawn: Drawn: {n} objects on the TRUSS-* layers (one undo step). Save as DXF or DWG as for any drawing.
h.cadcraft.limit.entities: CadCraft: the drawings are plain lines, polylines, text, hatches and dimensions on the TRUSS-* layers. They do not follow the design if you edit them; draw again (Remove the drawings first). Nothing is drawn in 3D.
h.cadcraft.limit.roofs: CadCraft has no roof model to read: type the roof outline, or take it from a selected closed polyline. Hips and valleys come from the straight skeleton of that outline at one pitch; per-edge pitches and gables need BimCraft's roof tool.
